figures.caption: Figure 2: ircadian phase distribution of seizure onsets relative to band-limited IBI circadian phase (0.8–1.2 days) in a single patient (𝑛 = 29 seizures). (a) Polar scatter showing individual seizure phases with mean resultant vector (𝑅 = 0.55). (b) Rose histogram (12 bins) illustrating clustering in late-day hours. The Rayleigh test confirms significant deviation from uniformity (𝑝 = 7.5 × 10−5), indicating that seizure onsets preferentially occur at a specific circadian phase rather than being evenly distributed across the cycle.
